name: God On High
overview: Scripture reveals God as the exalted and eternal One who dwells in the highest and holiest place, yet intimately engages with those who are humble and contrite in spirit, offering revival and restoration. This divine transcendence is harmonized with the profound expression of God's love through the giving of His only begotten Son, Jesus Christ. Through Christ, who declares Himself as the way, the truth, and the life, believers are granted access to the Father, emphasizing that the exalted God on high is also personally accessible through faith in Jesus.
